harness: vitest defaults via npm test; importRouteWithMocks pattern; adapter/model/audit/environment injected via factories; vi.mock only for Supabase auth boundary

cases.asserts: single-alias displayable hit returns answer envelope with that authority's citation_display and environment_echo.mock=true
multi-alias query returns envelopes for each resolved alias; unresolved alias appears as miss, not error
searchChunks path returns clamped list; limit request of 200 yields at most 50 envelopes
gated row (deny_until_approved) yields restricted_display_only refusal; response contains no chunk metadata beyond gate summary
row with production_display_status blocking yields the same gated refusal; no partial content leak
guardrail_reference_only (DCS-like) rows alone cannot produce a general answer envelope
zero-envelope query returns no_authority_support refusal, never a model-knowledge answer
future-effective-only result set with earlier as_of_date returns future_effective_only refusal and echoes as_of_date_used
adapter timeout trigger returns error envelope with retriable=true; no answer, no refusal misclassification
malformed adapter payload fails schema guard and returns error envelope; nothing from the malformed payload reaches the prompt

cross_checks: every answer envelope in this file also asserts audit_record_ref present
as_of_date passthrough verified by fixed date injection, no wall-clock reads
